# carreir (`SMC17/carreir`)

> Physical-intelligence substrate for HVAC and cold-chain in Zig 0.16 with TLA+ model-checked HMAC-SHA256 audit logs (AGPL-3.0).

## Key Links
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SMC17/carreir
- **Related (`zig-substrate`)**: https://github.com/SMC17/zinging
- **Author / Org**: https://github.com/SMC17

## Modules & Key Files
- [README](README.md) & [Status](STATUS.md)
- [Build](build.zig) & [Source](src)
  - `psychrometric/` — ASHRAE 2021 Ch.1 moist-air primitives
  - `refrigerant/` — NIST saturation P-T tables (R-134a, R-410A, R-32, R-1234yf, R-744)
  - `coldchain/` — HMAC-SHA256 append-only reefer log with TLA+ formal spec
  - `chiller/` — comptime safety invariants for vapor-compression cycles
